author: llm (Claude Sonnet 5.5), hand-written literal tensors, 2026-09-30
notes: Argument-slot version. Sparse tensors: unlisted entries 0. Entry [row_spec, col_spec, w]: specs are ints or 'a-b' int ranges (ASCII codes); col_spec '=' means col==row, 'upper' col=row-32, 'lower' col=row+32, '*' every col. Executing tool calls is done by the harness, not by the weights.

arg_matcher.desc: A[p][c] = how much text byte c satisfies pattern byte p. Pattern (<=8 bytes) is the INPUT; byte 0 is padding = wildcard. Line matches if some window scores > 8 - 0.5.

arg_matcher_ci.desc: same, case-insensitive: letters also satisfy their other case

slots.desc: per-token features f=[is_first_quoted,is_second_quoted,prev_token_is_for,is_router_vocab_word,has_dot]; each slot picks argmax token of W_slot@f, or null if best score <= null_bias

router.desc: bag-of-keywords -> action; argmax over W@v+b, ties to lowest index
